kurzfassung: Megyn Kelly covers the FBI arrest of Meghan Markle's father, Thomas Markle Sr., on child pornography charges and examines his non-denial statements. The program also details the ongoing legal battle and escalating controversy surrounding Amy Griffin's memoir, including interviews and dueling claims. Additional topics include Russell Brand's sentencing and political reactions to recent elections.
